title: An overview of Artillery and Vegeta

videos.script: Two more load generators, both smaller than the four before them. {{two}} Artillery writes the test as YAML. A configuration file, not a program. {{yaml}} Phases say how many visitors arrive each second. A flow says what each one does: look at a show, think, book a seat. {{flow}} An ensure block holds the thresholds. When one fails, Artillery exits with one, and the pipeline sees it. {{ensure}} Vegeta is smaller still. One line per request, a rate, a duration. {{vegeta}} Three commands joined by pipes. Attack, then report. And the results can be reported again later. {{pipe}} Vegeta never waits for an answer before the next request is due. Ask for more than the box office can serve, and the line of waiting requests grows, and Vegeta reports every second of it. {{backlog}} Last, the six tools of lessons four to seven, side by side, and how to pick two of them. {{table}}
